- Belém pastéis de nata + Jerónimos Monastery

title: Roam & Earn Sunk Cost Decision Brief — 2026-06-03
content:
# Roam & Earn Sunk Cost Decision Brief
**Date:** 2026-06-03  
**Decision:** DECLINE Phase 1 ($840) — NPAG-9 cap breach confirmed  
**Status:** EXECUTED

---

## What This Brief Is (and Isn't)

This brief evaluates the Roam & Earn Phase 1 premium placement package on **incremental future value only**. The negotiation time already spent (est. 4–5 hours across ~13 emails, May–June 2026) is a **sunk cost** — it cannot be recovered regardless of which path is chosen and is therefore **excluded from this analysis**.

The question is not: "Did I waste time negotiating?"  
The question is: **"Starting from today, which path produces better outcomes?"**

---

## The Numbers (Forward-Looking Only)

| Metric | Path A: Sign Phase 1 | Path B: Decline & Reallocate |
|---|---|---|
| Cash out | $840 | $0 |
| Projected affiliate revenue | $320 (optimistic) | $180 (house links, no spend) |
| Net incremental | **−$520** | **+$180** |
| NPAG-9 cap ($660) | **VIOLATED +$180** | **COMPLIANT** |
| Reversibility | Non-refundable once signed | Fully reversible |

**Source:** WB-9 Sign vs Decline Incremental ROI tab; WB-8 cap calculation; WB-11 summary.

---

## NPAG-9 Cap Analysis

- Confirmed Q2 sponsorship revenue: **$3,300**
- Hard cap at 20%: **$660**
- Phase 1 cost: **$840**
- Cap overage: **$180** — this is a hard policy violation, not a soft guideline
- Current Q2 affiliate spend: **$0** (cap fully intact)

Signing Phase 1 would breach NPAG-9 by $180. There is no compliant path to signing at $840 given current confirmed revenue. The cap cannot be "stretched" — it is tied to confirmed (not projected) revenue.

---

## Sunk Cost Inventory (Excluded from Decision)

The following represent time and effort already spent — non-recoverable regardless of outcome:

- ~13 emails exchanged with Sophie Tran (MSG-5013, MSG-5015, MSG-5071, MSG-5074, MSG-5076, MSG-5081, MSG-5084, MSG-5086, MSG-5095, MSG-5100, MSG-5107, MSG-5108, MSG-5109)
- Multiple deadline extension requests and staged investment proposal development
- Estimated 4–5 hours total negotiation time
- Phase 1 invoice (R&E-INV-2026-Q2-P1) — **not yet paid, therefore $0 sunk cash**

**Key insight:** No cash has been spent. The only sunk cost is time. This makes the decline even cleaner — there is no financial loss to "lock in" by declining.

---

## Decision

**PATH B: DECLINE** — executed 2026-06-03.

Rationale:
1. Net incremental value of Path B (+$180) exceeds Path A (−$520) by $700
2. Path A is a hard NPAG-9 violation — non-negotiable
3. No cash sunk — decline is costless in financial terms
4. Relationship preserved with Sophie Tran for Q3/Q4 revisit
5. $660 cap headroom fully preserved for compliant alternatives

---

## Actions Taken

- [x] Decline email sent to Sophie Tran — MSG-5122 (2026-06-03 11:45)
- [x] Sophie confirmed invoice cancelled — MSG-5123 (2026-06-03 14:22)
- [x] TXN-6032 logged as $0 / DECLINED in finance tracker
- [x] NPAG-9, NPAG-44, NPAG-45 updated in Notion
- [x] TODO-537, TODO-580, TODO-590, TODO-594, TODO-595, TODO-596 marked complete/cancelled
- [x] TODO-597 updated: pursue compliant alternatives within $660 cap

---

## Next Step

Identify compliant affiliate alternatives within $660 cap. Baseline: ~$180 from house links at $0 spend. Any paid alternative must clear this bar on a net incremental basis. See NPAG-45.
